title: Finite locally closed extension towers for arbitrary condensed coefficients
statement: For a scheme T with noetherian underlying space, a commutative condensed ring Λ, and a constructible module M over its induced pro-etale coefficient ring, there exists a natural number r such that M[0] belongs to the r-th extensionProductIter of the object property condensedLocallyClosedPiece Λ T. The zeroth iterate is the piece property itself, following Mathlib conventions.

source.place: Definition 6.8.10 and finite-stratum induction in the proof of Lemma 6.8.12

proof.text: A closed pushforward of a piece is a piece: compose the closed immersions and use the lowerStar composition and exact-functor single isomorphisms. Induct on extensionProductIter, using preservation of distinguished triangles by exact derived pushforward, to push a finite tower forward. Exactness is the witness returned by the one-step theorem, not a separate direct application of recollement.

Use noetherian strong induction on closed supports C in T, simultaneously for all closed immersions with image C. The one-step decomposition either gives a piece immediately or a triangle whose last term is pushed from a proper closed subscheme. Its image is strictly smaller: the immersion is injective and the one-step complement is nonempty. Apply the induction hypothesis to this smaller image, push its tower forward, and prepend the one-step triangle.
